lead.event: MSCI downgrade proposal and Indonesian market reforms amid transparency concerns
lead.headline: MSCI proposes standalone status, freezes additions as OJK targets 15% free float
lead.blurb: The proposed move from emerging-market to standalone status reflects concerns over investability, ownership transparency, market integrity and enforcement. OJK's response includes disclosure of concentrated ownership and a gradual increase in minimum free float to 15%, with a 15% minimum for IPOs effective 31 March. Pending its review, MSCI will not raise Indonesian stocks' foreign inclusion factors or advance postponed weight increases and migrations to larger-priority indexes. Consultation runs through 30 April, with a final decision due by 30 June 2027.
lead.copy_decision: rewritten: 3 new articles with a new fact: MSCI froze additions of Indonesian stocks to its indexes while its review is pending.

earnings_guidance.event: GoTo reports Q3 profit and raises EBITDA target amid analyst target-price revision
earnings_guidance.headline: GOTO reports Q3 profit and raises 2026 EBITDA target to Rp3.5 trillion-Rp3.7 trillion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Nine-month net profit reached Rp1.16 trillion, versus a Rp775 billion loss a year earlier. Q3 net profit was Rp441 billion, up about 75% from the previous quarter. Phintraco Sekuritas cut its target price from Rp80 to Rp40 while retaining a buy recommendation.

earnings_guidance.event: Kiwoom Sekuritas lowers Bank Mandiri valuation and price target
earnings_guidance.headline: Kiwoom cuts BMRI valuation and price target despite 20.7% profit growth
earnings_guidance.blurb: Kiwoom Sekuritas lowered its valuation and price target for Bank Mandiri amid rising market uncertainty. The bank’s nine-month 2026 net profit rose 20.7% year on year to Rp45.5 trillion.

earnings_guidance.event: Pantai Indah Kapuk Dua reports nine-month 2026 profit growth
earnings_guidance.headline: PANI reports 145% nine-month 2026 profit growth
earnings_guidance.blurb: Pantai Indah Kapuk Dua's revenue rose 19% to Rp3.7 trillion, while profit attributable to the parent reached Rp1.9 trillion. Commercial land handovers in the CBD PIK2 area contributed about 60% of revenue, and the Hilton Hotel PIK2 is expected to begin operations in the second half of 2027.

earnings_guidance.event: MIND ID mining issuers report sharp profit growth through Q3 2026
earnings_guidance.headline: MIND ID miners report profit growth through Q3 2026, with TINS up 584%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Higher commodity prices, production and sales volumes, and cost efficiency supported profit growth. Aneka Tambang’s profit rose 46% to Rp9.66 trillion, Bukit Asam’s grew 216.3% to Rp4.41 trillion, Vale Indonesia’s tripled to US$147 million, and Timah’s jumped 584% to Rp4.12 trillion. Analysts expect commodity prices to support results through end-2026, but forecast more moderate growth in 2027.
